title: How many branches can the root lose?
hook: Does the usual low-link test work unchanged at the root?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish the DFS-root articulation rule from the nonroot low-link rule.

misconception: Any root with an edge to a child is an articulation point.
objective: Distinguish the DFS-root articulation rule from the nonroot low-link rule.
